liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the greatest version of They Love Each Other ever [10]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Reviewer calls Don't Ease Me In the highlight of the first set so far [11]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer notes nice high notes from Jerome but says it drags the set down [11]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Reviewer finds the segue from China Cat into Rider long and fantastic [11]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls Playin' crazy [8]
- **Her Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Reviewer calls Here Comes Sunshine rare, and says a Dark Star Orchestra show with it evoked 1973 [3]
- **Weather Report Suite Part #1** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Weather Report Suite into Eyes of the World splendid [8]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Let It Grow as unspeakably good, deserving special mention [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Her Comes Sunshine**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **To Lay Me Down**: back after 245 archived shows (1097 days) [14]
- **GoinÃÂÃÂ Down The Road FeelinÃÂÃÂ Bad**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]

## The recordings

- **gd73-11-09.sbd.kaplan.2657.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 184 min; rated 4.38/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard quality good; Reviewer finds the sound of this show lacking next to the premium quality of the 11/11 recording; Says the radio cassette sounds somewhat better than this download, but not as good as 11/11 [2][4][6][8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer heard Dark Star Orchestra at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles, with one drummer, opening with Promised Land [3]
- Reviewer arriving at seats heard this song playing; the band apparently began over half an hour early [5]
- Reviewer calls this the first night of a historic Winterland run [9]
- Uploader's list shows Uncle John's Band as the encore [1]
- Reviewer says this night is a winner that deserves attention, though the two following Winterland shows get most of the press [2]
- Says 11/9 and 11/10 have weaker sound than 11/11, making comparison with 11/11 unfair [4]
- Finds 11/9 has more energy and faster tempos than 11/11, though 11/11 sounds better [6]
- Rated about 4 to 4.5 stars compared with the next two nights, which are 5-star shows [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-11-09.sbd.kaplan.2657.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard transferred via MR, cassette, DAT and CDR, then EAC to SHN by Seth [1]
